$comment: The decisions the API x platform matrix cannot measure, each with its reason. Everything else in
contracts/runtime/api-platform-matrix.json is derived: what an API reaches is measured by calling it
(minigame-api-reach.json), and what each platform's host layer provides is read from its sources. Generated by
pure: reaches no op and needs nothing from a host -- the engine's own state or a value it defines. Declared,
because an API that reaches nothing may instead be one the probe could not get past its own validation.
via: needs what another API needs -- a setter whose value travels with that API's request, a status that
API's events keep current, a precondition that API meets.
input: is fed by the host's input or lifecycle rather than called through to it; the kind names the host
entry point that feeds it (see INPUT in the generator).
gaps: the engine answers, but the answer is invented or a stub, or the host has no way to supply the real
one. Missing on the platforms named until fixed; each is a work item.
unsupported: deliberately not offered on the platforms named, for the reason given; content feature-detects.
host_owned: needs that are the host app's by nature -- its ad, payment, account and social integrations, its
updates of the content package, the consent it gives -- so a platform that offers them as a host interface is
Platforms: android, ios, macos, linux, windows, ohos; "*" is all of them.

pure.createImageData: ImageData is memory the engine allocates
pure.createPath2D: a path is the engine's own geometry
pure.getEnterOptionsSync: the options the host passed when it last showed the game, which the engine keeps
pure.getFileSystemManager: the file system is the engine's own
pure.getLaunchOptionsSync: the options the host passed when it first showed the game, which the engine keeps
pure.getLogManager: log entries go to the engine's console
pure.onAudioInterruptionBegin: the engine's audio output reports interruptions where the platform has them
pure.onAudioInterruptionEnd: the engine's audio output reports interruptions where the platform has them
pure.onMessage: messages between the game and its open data context, both the engine's
pure.onWindowResize: the surface size the host reports with every surface it attaches

createVideoDecoder.reason: every method is a no-op; no decoder is integrated

navigateBackMiniProgram.reason: the Java SDK's NavigationHandler has no way back to the mini program that opened this one

onAudioInterruptionBegin.reason: the OpenHarmony audio output does not report interruptions yet

onAudioInterruptionEnd.reason: the OpenHarmony audio output does not report interruptions yet

saveFileToDisk.reason: throws; the save dialog is the platform's

createInferenceSession.reason: on-device inference needs a model runtime per platform; not offered

createVKSession.reason: the visual kit (AR tracking) needs a vision runtime per platform; not offered

faceDetect.reason: face detection needs a vision runtime per platform; not offered

getGPU.reason: WebGPU is not implemented on any platform; content feature-detects it

initFaceDetect.reason: face detection needs a vision runtime per platform; not offered

isVKSupport.reason: the visual kit is not offered

saveFileToDisk.reason: the platform documents it for PC only

setWindowSize.reason: an app on a phone cannot size its own window

vibrateLong.reason: a desktop has no motor in the device the player holds, and the platform documents vibration for phones; a gamepad's motors are its vibrationActuator

vibrateShort.reason: a desktop has no motor in the device the player holds, and the platform documents vibration for phones; a gamepad's motors are its vibrationActuator
